allowlistHelp: Only these IPv4 addresses (CIDR) may connect. The server binds 127.0.0.1 — this is defence-in-depth.
authNote: Use the gateway token as the API key — Authorization: Bearer <token> or x-api-key: <token>.
connectHelp: Point any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible client at the gateway by setting one of these environment variables.
description: Expose your configured providers as a local OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoint so external tools can borrow Cognia's routing and credentials.
desktopOnlyNotice: The gateway needs an HTTP listener and is available only in the desktop app.
enabledHelp: Run the local HTTP server. Off by default; requires a token.
logHelp: The last inbound calls the gateway handled.
requiresToken: Generate a token before enabling the gateway.
title: Inbound Gateway
tokenHelp: External tools authenticate with this token. Stored in the OS keyring; regenerate to revoke.
